notes.title: Escape First 2 is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello and Welcome to Escape First 2[/h1]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35143621/761eb6e41141c7fd69753a36d46e9ef6d060fc8c.png[/img]

Escape First 2 is a multiplayer escape room adventure game that features three unique experiences to play through! It is the second entry in the series, bringing you more rooms and more refined interactions. Gather up to six people and work together to solve puzzles and escape before time is up!

But wait, there is more, you can choose to play as a Team, using cooperation to win the game, or you can enable Challenge Mode hand race your friends to the exit!

If you haven't already, you can check the original "Escape First" out here :

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/850450/Escape_First/] https://store.steampowered.com/app/850450/Escape_First/[/url]

(You can play the games in either order, they are largely independent)

Who will Escape First?

Thank you and have a great time escaping!
